cim: When to Build a Custom AI Model? RAG vs. Fine-Tuning
cim_eredeti: When to Build a Custom AI Model? RAG vs. Fine-Tuning
szoveg_eredeti:
An AI-SDLC audit will help your team decide where automation is worth the investment before you commit to a build. Follow a deployment lookup that starts with a testing ticket, from a specific problem statement to an agent design and a proposed pilot. See what the three audit deliverables give your team and how to evaluate the workflow afterward.

A reviewer produced 155 confirmed findings and five rounds of work. Szymon Chmal explains how that experience shaped Simlock’s review process, from specialist agents and verified findings to targeted rechecks and historical replays.

Join Kewin Wereszczyński and Hanno Gödecke on November 12 for live demos and a discussion of the Mobile Dev plugin and AI-powered mobile workflows.

Join us at React Foundation Meetup London on November 11 to explore how AI agents build and debug React Native apps, from one terminal to the cloud.

Explore an anonymized software factory business case, its delivery workflow, and the staffing assumptions behind a projected 65% reduction in total costs.

Amazon’s Anisha Malde joins Łukasz Chludziński to discuss harness engineering, agent skills, and how AI is changing cross-platform development.

Learn how to research requirements, resolve open decisions, and write testable specs that AI coding agents can implement without the planning conversation.

Plan codebase migrations with coding agents using reviewable requirements, verification checks, staged rollouts, and defined rollback criteria.

Explore conversational banking architecture through a card-dispute example, covering tool access, authorization, execution, observability, and human handoff.

Join Kewin Wereszczyński and Szymon Chmal to explore what can go wrong in a React Native software factory overnight and the controls that keep agents on track.

Matt Hargett explains how AI moves bottlenecks across testing, deployment, infrastructure, support, and the rest of software delivery.

Tzvetan Mikov discusses AI coding agents, context switching, low-level engine optimization, reviewing specs and tests, and his plans for Hermes X.

Learn how React Native AI uses a unified provider model to switch between cloud and on-device LLMs without rewriting application logic, enabling reliable AI experiences online and offline.

Learn how on-device models in React Native can call tools, interact with external APIs, and return structured outputs you can use directly in application logic.

Learn how to run third-party on-device LLMs in React Native using MLC LLM. Choose your models, run them efficiently across platforms, and keep a unified JavaScript API with React Native AI.

Learn how to use Apple’s built-in Foundation Models in React Native apps, reduce memory usage, and enable fast, fully on-device AI with React Native AI Apple.

Learn why on-device AI matters for React Native apps, how local LLMs behave offline, and what problems React Native AI is designed to solve from day one.

Learn how to implement a React Native TurboModule on Android, from the TypeScript spec and Codegen to the Kotlin implementation and package registration.

Learn how JavaScript, native module, background, and main threads interact in React Native TurboModules, and how to use GCD queues to run async work safely in Swift.

Learn how to expose typed, immutable constants from a Swift TurboModule using Codegen, and get full end-to-end type safety between native and JavaScript.

Learn how to emit native events from a Swift TurboModule and subscribe to them in JavaScript, including proper memory management and Codegen integration.

Learn how to build a fully working TurboModule in Swift, integrate it with Codegen, and bridge it through Objective‑C inside an Expo app.

prioritas.indok: Technikai jellegű oktató/marketing blogbejegyzés RAG és fine-tuning témában.
prioritas.cim_hu: RAG vagy Fine-Tuning: hogyan válasszunk egyedi AI modellt?
prioritas.lead_hu: Egy technikai útmutató részletezi, milyen lépések alapján érdemes eldönteni a saját AI modellek építését vagy a meglévők finomhangolását.
